skill_name: Compare and contrast the major characteristics of two web browsers - Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox.
workflow:
Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox are two of the most popular web browsers available. Both have several features that make them attractive to users, but there are also key differences between them. 

Google Chrome is known for its speed, which is often faster than that of Mozilla Firefox. It also has a minimalistic user interface and an extensive library of extensions and add-ons.
